title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Our client is a leading civil construction services company; they are now seeking an experienced Digital Marketing Manager to join their team. You will be responsible for driving digital lead generation, pipeline growth, and brand visibility across the UK business, with occasional support for US initiatives. The role covers digital campaigns, website optimisation, SEO, analytics, events, content, and CRM workflows.

Responsibilities
- Plan and optimise digital campaigns across email, paid social, web and manage end-to-end campaign delivery and performance reporting.
- Improve ROI through continuous testing and optimisation.
- Align activity with commercial and sales priorities.
- Manage and update the WordPress website - Improve UX, performance, and conversion rates.
- Develop SEO strategies to grow organic visibility.
- Optimise content for emerging AI/LLM search environments.
- Build dashboards and track digital KPIs.
- Analyse website and campaign data to generate insights and support data-driven decision-making across the business.
- Support planning and delivery of events, exhibitions, and conferences.
- Develop promotional plans and coordinate suppliers and internal teams.
- Manage timelines and deliverables.
- Coordinate brochures, product literature, presentations, and digital assets.
- Maintain brand consistency across all materials.
- Support photography, video, and visual content creation.

Requirements
- Proven B2 B digital marketing experience.
- Experience in industrial, technical, engineering, manufacturing, or business services.
- Hands-on delivery of digital campaigns and website management.
- Strong Google Ads, WordPress, SEO, and analytics skills.
- Ability to interpret data and turn insights into action.
- Experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager and marketing automation.
- Photography, video, and content creation capability.
- Understanding of AI/LLM search optimisation.
- Event and exhibition support experience.
- CRM experience.
- Strong understanding of segmentation and GDPR.

Benefits
- Competitive Benefits package
- Ongoing career development opportunities
- Hybrid working

Some UK Travel required.

title: Marketing and Communications Manager
description:
Are you ready to lead marketing strategy and drive customer engagement across a dynamic commercial enterprise? Abingdon School has an exciting Marketing and Communications Manager opportunity!

Location: Park Road, Abingdon, Oxfordshire, OX14 1 DE

Salary: £30,950 to £37,766 per annum

Job Type: Fixed Term Contract (1 year)

Hours: 40 hours per week

Closing Date: 02 November 2026

About Us:

The Foundation comprises two schools: Abingdon School and Abingdon Prep School, as well as Abingdon School Enterprises. Abingdon School is a leading independent day and boarding school with more than 1,000 pupils aged 11-18. Currently a boys' school, it will become co-educational from September 2026.

Abingdon Prep School is a vibrant and warm day preparatory school with around 200 pupils aged 4-13 which has been co-educational since last year. Both Schools are situated in beautiful and extensive grounds, with the senior school in the heart of Abingdon on Thames, just south of Oxford, and the Prep School located a few miles away in nearby Frilford.

Marketing and Communications Manager - The Role:

You will lead ASE's marketing strategy, budget and customer engagement across all commercial activities. Working closely with the Commercial Director and Leadership Team, you will translate commercial ambitions into campaigns, customer journeys and content activity. This is a highly visible, field-based role requiring you to attend events and customer touchpoints regularly, create content, track performance and develop marketing ownership across ASE teams. You will drive awareness, demand generation, conversion, retention and customer insight while maintaining a consistent, high-quality customer experience.

Marketing and Communications Manager - Key Responsibilities:
- Own ASE's marketing strategy, annual plan and delegated budget, managing campaigns, brand positioning, digital performance and customer engagement across all propositions
- Develop and implement brand standards, visual identity and tone of voice, acting as guardian of consistent customer-facing language and experience across ASE
- Manage the ASE website, app and social media channels with accountability for discoverability, conversion and performance measurement including reach, engagement and traffic
- Establish customer feedback mechanisms, capture insights and design methods to measure marketing effectiveness including campaign tracking, QR codes and booking-source analysis
- Maintain regular presence at ASE venues, events and touchpoints to understand customer journeys first-hand, gather content and identify improvements
- Create delegated marketing and content ownership opportunities across ASE teams with clear standards and approval routes
- Identify revenue opportunities through packaging, upselling and engagement improvements across the sales funnel
- Report on key performance measures including awareness, enquiry generation, website traffic, booking conversion, retention and customer feedback

Marketing and Communications Manager - You:
- Hold a degree or professional qualification in Marketing, Communications, Business or related discipline, with proven experience in a similar Marketing and Communications Manager role
- Demonstrate experience managing digital content, website structures, data analytics and marketing budgets
- Show excellent understanding of multi-channel marketing campaigns, print production and digital advertising with exceptional attention to detail
- Display outstanding copyediting, proofreading and interpersonal skills with ability to manage competing deadlines and communicate confidently with stakeholders
- Possess strong knowledge of GDPR, data protection and child safeguarding rules regarding media use in schools

Benefits:
- 25 days paid annual leave plus 8 bank holidays, plus 4 additional non-contractual days during Christmas closure
- Generous contributory pension scheme with 14.1% employer contribution
- Private healthcare insurance
- Free lunches during term time
- Free on-site parking and bike storage
- Free use of leisure facilities with discounted exercise classes
- Cycle to work scheme
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Abingdon Foundation Death in Service Scheme
- Free on-site courses including first aid, mental health first aid and health and safety
- Regular staff social events
- Discounted school fees (eligibility criteria apply)
- Flexible working from home may be available

Closing Date: 02 November 2026

Interview Date: 10 November 2026

We recognise the value of a diverse and inclusive workplace and are committed to equality of

opportunity for all staff and job applicants.

Early applications are encouraged. We may make an appointment prior to the advertised closing or interview dates.

Abingdon is committed to safeguarding the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment. All appointments are subject to a satisfactory enhanced DBS check.

To submit your CV for this exciting Marketing and Communications Manager opportunity, click Apply today!

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
Berry Recruitment are NOW hiring for a committed and experienced Marketing Assistant to work for a company in Didcot, Oxfordshire

Role: Marketing Assistant

Salary: 35,000.00 per annum

Location: Didcot, Oxfordshire

Hours: Monday - Friday, 9am - 5pm

Key Responsibilities of the Marketing Assistant:
- Planning, creating, and uploading varied and engaging content regularly to our website and managed social media channels.
- Overseeing channel interactions and replying/building the community online.
- Analysing and reporting on trends and good/bad posts with a view to improving our output month to month.
- Maintaining our website and updating product/brand listings.
- Managing our external email communications.
- Supporting our wider marketing activities.

About you:
- Successful applicants should have good experience or knowledge in multi-channel, multi-brand social media management and good web strategy, ideally some experience with META analytics and handling of monthly budgets.
- You should also have an engaging writing style for times when body text and video scripts are required, and an awareness of the impact your interactions can have on the appearance of the company.
- A keen interest in consumer electronics and knowledge of design tools is preferred, but not essential.

No candidate will meet every single desired qualification we have listed. If your experience looks a little different but you think you can role; value to the role, we'd love to learn more about you!"

For more information and to apply, contact the Oxford branch of Berry Recruitment - (phone number removed) or click 'Apply Now' to submit your application.

We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. All applicants will be considered on the basis of their skills, experience, qualifications and ability to perform the role, and no applicant will be treated less favourably because of a protected characteristic under the Equality Act 2010.

title: Marketing Assistant/office assistant
description:
Role: Office/ Marketing Assistant

Company: Bruce Hopkins
Location: Shenington, Oxfordshire
Hours: Part-time preferred, with the potential for full-time hours

About Bruce Hopkins:

Bruce Hopkins Ltd is an established family-run business based at Shenington Airfield, near Banbury, Oxfordshire, with over 50 years of experience in the agricultural, groundcare and construction machinery industries.

We sell new and used machinery, supply parts, and provide servicing and maintenance for a wide range of equipment. We work with leading manufacturers, including Polaris, Bobcat and Milwaukee, supporting our customers with quality products and reliable after-sales service.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and organised Office & Marketing Assistant to join our team, supporting the day-to-day running of the business while helping to maintain and grow our website, social media and online presence.

About the Role:

You will be responsible for:
- Answering telephone calls and handling general enquiries,
- Managing our social media channels,
- Creating engaging content to promote the business and the products we offer. This will include writing blogs and updating content on our website.
- Helping to organise and promote company events, including our annual Ride & Drive events, as well as supporting the team at external events and shows such as Moreton Show.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys a varied role and is happy to get involved in all aspects of the business. You will work closely with the team, gaining knowledge of our products and industry, with manufacturer training and support available where required.

Required:
- Able to commute to Shenington
- Good knowledge of social media
- Confident answering phones and responding to emails

Hours: 3/4 days a week, with the potential for full-time hours

19 days holiday

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive
Hybrid Full Time Permanent
About the Employer
An established UK technology business providing IT infrastructure, data protection, disaster recovery and enterprise technology solutions to organisations across a range of sectors. Working closely with leading global technology vendors, the company combines specialist technical expertise with long-standing industry experience to help customers protect, manage and modernise business-critical IT environments.

The Role
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a hands-on Marketing Executive to join a growing B2 B technology marketing team. This practical, delivery-focused position will play an important role in turning marketing strategies into effective, measurable campaigns across digital channels.
Working closely with marketing, sales and SDR colleagues, you will build and manage campaigns in HubSpot, create landing pages and email sequences, develop marketing assets, support PPC and social media activity, and monitor campaign performance. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised marketer looking to develop their expertise in B2 B technology, campaign management and digital marketing.

Duties & Responsibilities
- Build and manage integrated marketing campaigns in HubSpot, including emails, landing pages, forms, lists, workflows and associated campaign assets.
- Maintain and organise the HubSpot portal to ensure campaigns, marketing assets, data and reporting remain accurate and consistent.
- Produce campaign reports and dashboards, monitoring marketing performance against agreed KPIs and objectives.
- Create professional landing pages, email campaigns and marketing resources in line with established brand and editorial guidelines.
- Plan, create and publish engaging social media content, particularly for LinkedIn, while supporting paid digital and PPC campaigns.
- Collaborate with marketing, SDR and sales teams to understand briefs and deliver both long-term campaigns and fast-turnaround marketing projects.
- Create and adapt visual marketing assets using Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud applications, while supporting website content development and management.
- Support channel and co-marketing campaigns with major technology vendors and strategic partners.

Education & Skills Required
- A degree in marketing or a related discipline, or an equivalent professional marketing qualification such as CIM, would be advantageous.
- Previous marketing experience, ideally within B2 B IT, technology or a channel environment such as a vendor, reseller, MSP or technology partner.
- Strong HubSpot skills covering campaign creation, management, automation, organisation, reporting and performance measurement.
- Experience creating professional landing pages, email campaigns, digital marketing content and associated campaign assets.
- Working knowledge of Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, combined with excellent written and spoken English and strong attention to detail.
- An organised, collaborative and dependable approach, with the ability to manage varied workloads, meet deadlines and communicate effectively with sales, SDR and marketing stakeholders. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.
- Hybrid.
- Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:30pm.
- Banbury.
- Salary: 30 k to 35 k. (Depending on experience)

If you are an enthusiastic and detail-focused Marketing Executive looking to develop your career within the B2 B technology sector, this is an excellent opportunity to take ownership of meaningful campaigns and expand your digital marketing expertise. Apply today to take the next step in your marketing career.

For a discreet, detailed discussion about the role, you can reach out to Vanessa Rodriguez at or email

title: Marketing Manager - FTC
description:
Marketing Manager

6-Month FTC / Interim (Day Rate Considered)

Immediate or short-notice availability is highly desirable.

Are you a creative, commercially minded Marketing professional who loves bringing consumer brands to life?

The Advocate Group is excited to be partnering with an established FMCG business looking for an experienced Marketing Manager to take ownership of a high-profile brand development project.

This is an exciting opportunity to shape the next chapter of a consumer brand, bringing fresh thinking, creativity, and commercial expertise to strengthen its positioning and drive growth.

We're looking for someone who combines strategic brand thinking with hands-on execution, turning consumer insights into compelling brand propositions and impactful marketing activity.

Key Responsibilities:
- Take ownership of an exciting consumer brand project, shaping its positioning, marketing strategy and commercial development.
- Use consumer and shopper insights to identify opportunities, strengthen the brand proposition and drive consumer engagement.
- Bring fresh, creative thinking to brand communications, packaging, digital marketing and activation to build a distinctive and engaging brand.
- Work closely with external creative agencies to develop compelling brand assets, campaigns and marketing initiatives.
- Develop and execute a clear go-to-market strategy, working alongside commercial teams to drive retail engagement and growth.
- Lead cross-functional project delivery, managing timelines, key milestones and stakeholders to ensure successful execution.
- Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders, confidently presenting recommendations, influencing decisions and driving projects forward.

About You:
- Strong background in Brand/Commercial/Tade Marketing within FMCG, with experience in consumer brand development.
- Proven experience leading brand launches, shaping brand strategy, developing consumer propositions, and delivering successful marketing initiatives.
- A creative, consumer-led marketer who can translate insights into engaging brand propositions and impactful campaigns.
- Strong commercial awareness, with an understanding of brand performance, P&L, and route-to-market strategies.
- Excellent project management and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to independently lead cross-functional initiatives through to execution.

If you're an experienced marketer who enjoys combining creativity, strategic thinking and commercial expertise to make a real impact, I'd love to hear from you!
